name: Nagima Chinami
source:
Hobbies: Surfing
Likes: The smell of used books, romantic stories, her grandfather
Dislikes: People who don't allow others to dream, hot things (has a sensitive tongue), cockroa... (can't say it)

[url=/c98086]Toshiki's[/url] cousin and [url=/c98083]Yumemi's[/url] older sister. She runs the bookstore, Nagima Bookstore, which she inherited from her late grandfather. Although she is a firm woman, she is also quite airheaded.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
